text:
I get wary when a woman seems to know me before she knows me. Maybe we’re twin flames already. Maybe she knows my motives better than I do. Maybe I’m Lord Krishna. Meanwhile she hasn’t asked that many questions yet. Maybe I really am way better than the other guys she’s found. Fine. I’m still going to turn out to be human.

I don’t hide that I still love women I’ve loved before. They come up because I actually think about them. Sometimes that ruins whatever perfect-man story she’s building around me. I’m not trying to make her jealous. If she can’t handle that I still love them, she isn’t ready for me.

If she says, “Can you talk about your exes less?” sure. Maybe I’m talking about them too much. But I don’t want a relationship where her whole inner world gets to come into the room and mine has to be edited first.
